_provenance_note: Family (b) web-archive domain ledger for tools/cdx_intake.py. Every entry MUST cite where the domain came from (a filing line in this repo's sources/, or a dossier/probe line): a domain invented by the tool is a lead with no provenance. This file deliberately does NOT live in tools/queries.json, which belongs to the harvest lanes; adding a family here does not re-write their 427 tasks. `window` is YYYY-YYYY and is the CDX from/to range. Slugs with no entry here are UNTRIED, not NULL -- cdx_intake.py writes an UNTRIED record for them.
_states: ANSWERED = bytes stored with sidecar; NULL = CDX answered 200 with zero captures in the window; UNANSWERED = 4xx/5xx/timeout/challenge, endpoint refused so the window was never tested; UNTRIED = no domain supplied / budget unspent.

centene.why: Stage 1/2 web presence of the registrant itself; the probe called family (b) the cheapest way to open a genuine second in-window Tier-1 family because the filings here are one self-reciting lineage.
centene.source_line: founders_playbook/01_companies/company_019_centene/research/A_chronology_feasibility.md l.88 and l.97 (FR-1: CDX snapshot set for centene.com + coordinatedcare.com over 1996-01-01..2002-12-31); domain self-declared in sources/sec/0000950109-01-504218_ds1.txt:374 'The address of our Web site is www.centene.com'

centene.why: Predecessor/operating-plan domain named in the same FR-1 request; Centene's growth was through health-plan acquisitions, so an alias domain can carry in-window text the parent domain does not.

Blue Cross Blue Shield of Kansas City, an Anthem-affiliated plan domain named in the same remedy line; a .org plan domain can hold in-window local text the holding company never published.

microsoft.why: The only company holding family-(b) artefacts on disk, and both are 503 banners: the earliest capture is NOT ESTABLISHED, so the route has never actually answered.
microsoft.source_line: founders_playbook/01_companies/company_011_microsoft/research/A_chronology_feasibility.md l.121 and l.204 ('Earliest capture of microsoft.com: NOT ESTABLISHED'); prior ad-hoc sidecars sources/web_archive/cdx_microsoft_com_earliest_200.json.sidecar.json and ..._retry.json.sidecar.json (both http_status 503, verdict UNANSWERED)

microsoft.why: The host the company itself told investors to visit; CDX matchType=domain on the apex already returns www URLs, so this entry tests whether the host form enumerates differently.

target.why: Family (b) is TRIED-UNANSWERED for Target, not UNTRIED: the manual CDX leg ran (U.026) and returned an Internet Archive outage body, never a capture. This is the registrant's own pre-rename domain, printed twice on the face of the FY1998 report, and Wayback's own floor is mid-1996, so the window opens there. NO run from this entry can produce in-window 1962-1975 Tier-1 text and the T2 verdict does not move whatever it returns -- the entry exists to close the scripted-route gap under 15.1, not to re-price a tier.
